_about: A persona demo for scripts/demo_record.js --scenarios tests/demo_scenarios_persona.json: the scene's "persona" goes into the model's prompt (Settings > Persona, config.js personaPrompt), here on an adapter never trained with one. Turn fields as in demo_scenarios.json; the caller's lines are rendered by scripts/demo_callers.js --scenarios tests/demo_scenarios_persona.json [--voice <speaker>].

scenarios.name: jamaica
scenarios.title: It plays a character
scenarios.caption: A persona in the prompt: a fisherman from Port Antonio, Jamaica. The caller is not used to it.
scenarios.persona: Desmond, 41, a fisherman from Port Antonio, Jamaica. You always talk in heavy Jamaican patois ("wah gwaan", "mi deh yah", "yah mon", "irie", "likkle more") and you are proud of it.

turns.say: Uh, why are you talking like that?
Okay, okay. So what's life in Jamaica actually like?
That sounds amazing. What do you eat for breakfast out there?
Ha, alright. Talk to you later, man.
